responsibility: Implements language-independent tree-aware diagnostic support used inside GCC compilers proper. It reports current function context, unwinds macro-expansion histories into note chains, installs a tree-specific diagnostic starter/finalizer configuration, formats tree operands for %D/%E/%F/%T diagnostic escapes, and computes inlining-location stacks so diagnostics can accurately describe source, macro, and inlined-call context for tree/GIMPLE-based warnings and errors.
same_name_distinction: Implements the tree-aware diagnostic behavior declared in gcc/tree-diagnostic.h, including current-function reporting, macro-expansion unwinding, default %D/%E/%F/%T formatting, inlining-location stack setup, and diagnostic-context defaults; the header just declares the hooks and tracking macros.
